title: Extension of scalars preserves K-flat module complexes
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in the same universe, ρ:A→B a unital ring homomorphism, and K a Z-indexed cochain complex of A-modules. Assume that Tot(F⊗_A K) is acyclic for every acyclic A-complex F (ordinary-module K-flatness [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], using the total tensor construction [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]). For every acyclic cochain complex L of B-modules, Tot(L⊗_B(B⊗_A K)) is acyclic. Extension of scalars is termwise Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalars ρ, including its maps on differentials. No flatness, injectivity, or boundedness hypothesis is imposed on ρ or K.

source.place: Tag 06Y1, lemma-base-change-K-flat, proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Y1

proof.text: Restriction of scalars sends L to an acyclic A-complex: all kernels and images are the same additive subgroups, so exactness is unchanged. This is also Mathlib exactness preservation for ModuleCat.restrictScalars, which preserves limits and colimits.

For a B-module N and A-module M, the balanced maps n⊗(b⊗m)↦(b n)⊗m and n⊗m↦n⊗(1⊗m) are inverse A-linear maps between the restriction of N⊗_B(B⊗_A M) and (restriction N)⊗_A M. Verify well-definedness using ρ, then inverseness on pure tensors. Apply these maps to each summand of total degree p+q=n. Their naturality commutes with both differentials and the sign (-1)^p, so they give an isomorphism of the restricted total tensor complex with the A-total tensor complex. Infinite direct sums cause no issue since the maps are defined summandwise.

Apply K-flatness of K to restricted L to obtain acyclicity of the A-total tensor complex. Transfer exactness degreewise across the chain isomorphism. Restriction of scalars reflects exactness for the same kernel/image reason from step 1, giving acyclicity over B.

theorem acyclic_mapBifunctor_extendScalars_of_kFlat
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (ρ : A →+* B)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, F.Acyclic →
      (mapBifunctor F K (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} B) ℤ) (hL : L.Acyclic) :
    (mapBifunctor L
      (((ModuleCat.extendScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
      (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic
